# Bloom & Grace

> Bloom & Grace is a Korean beauty (K-Beauty) boutique offering elegant, natural skincare, makeup, and personal care products with worldwide shipping.

Bloom & Grace curates premium Korean beauty products across skincare, makeup, body and hair care. Shoppers can browse the catalog, view daily rankings, get AI-personalized routine recommendations, and read a multilingual Q&A. The site supports English, Spanish, German, French, Portuguese, Japanese and Arabic, with prices shown in USD (with a EUR toggle).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured K-beauty products and brand story.
- [Shop All Products](/products): Full catalog with category filters and search.
- [Daily Ranking](/ranking): Best-selling and trending K-beauty products.
- [Q&A](/qa): Frequently asked questions on shipping, returns and product usage.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with customer support.
- [Trust & Safety](/trust): Shipping, returns, privacy and payment policies.

## Optional

- [Sign in](/auth): Account access for customers.
